Test: rasterised datasets

Source: R/test-docs.R
test_dataset_rounded.Rd

Flags every record of a dataset whose coordinates lie on a regular grid, as when records were collected or published per grid cell. For each axis the absolute coordinates are binned into about 3000 classes, the autocorrelation of the bin counts is computed, and its outliers (values above Q75 + T1 x IQR in sliding windows) are located; regularly spaced outliers, at a common distance between reg_dist_min and reg_dist_max degrees found at least reg_out_thresh times, mark the axis as periodic. A dataset fails when both axes are periodic (axis = "both") or the chosen one is. Datasets with fewer than min_unique_ds_size distinct coordinates are not tested.

Fields

lon, lat, dataset.

Settings

settings = list(dataset_rounded = list(...)) with T1 (7), reg_out_thresh (2), reg_dist_min (0.1), reg_dist_max (2), min_unique_ds_size (4) and axis ("both").

CoordinateCleaner

Equivalent to cd_round(); identical flags. In CoordinateCleaner 3.0.1 an input with several datasets of which one is below min_unique_ds_size stops with an error; here that dataset is not tested. Records without a dataset key are not flagged.

See also

flag_occurrences(), flag_tests()

Other tests: test_age_equal, test_age_outlier, test_age_range_outlier, test_aohi, test_basis, test_capital, test_centroid, test_country_mismatch, test_dataset_ddmm, test_duplicate, test_equal, test_establishment, test_gbif_headquarters, test_gbif_issue, test_habitat, test_institution, test_invalid, test_outlier, test_range, test_sea, test_spatiotemporal_outlier, test_urban, test_zero

Examples

set.seed(2)
x <- data.frame(datasetKey = rep(c("ok", "grid"), each = 400),
                decimalLongitude = c(runif(400, 0, 20), round(runif(400, 0, 20) * 2) / 2 + 0.01),
                decimalLatitude = c(runif(400, 0, 20), round(runif(400, 30, 50) * 2) / 2 + 0.01))
tapply(flag_occurrences(x, tests = "dataset_rounded")$flag_dataset_rounded, x$datasetKey, all)
